theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_slice_mass_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (a b : ℝ), Measurable f → MeasurableSet W → (∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, m t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, m t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b})
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
